profile.headline: Graphical Designer / Web Developer at LJR DESIGNS, LLC
profile.summary: Accumulating over twenty years of experience in the IT field with approximately 10 years of administrating Relational and Object-Relational Database Management System; including Help Desk, and Network System Management.  Advancing my development with Oracle systems, MS SQL Server, and Network maintenance.  Performing data design, analysis, and architecture of database-intensive applications in distributed client/server and web environments, assisted with the knowledge of installing Oracle database server software.  Creating databases, configuring networks for client computers and tuning databases, ensured high performance and data availability for developers and end-users.  Attending meetings with developers to conduct surveys to define system scope and functionality to manage user expectations with case analysis, refined system abstractions for development.  Assisting with the creation of Entity Relationship Diagrams of user and business requirements, helped identify objectives and criteria for testing supported upgrades and conversion.  Currently accumulated over four years experience within the Graphics Designs field, by creating a small Graphical design company.  Assisting small business’s competing in the global marketing.  Utilizing years of experience, and graphical software’s to produce unique, creative websites. Having interpersonal skills, the ability to handle multiple tasks and priorities, self-motivation, and displaying initiative is key in developing data design, and website.  Possessing the ability to understand and quickly apply new technologies and information has made me detail-oriented, organized, and enthusiastic to work in a fast paced team oriented environment.

positions.title: Graphical Designer / Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Created SharePoint 2013 site for client to handle growing company infrastructure
•	Designing and implementing site workflow utilizing Nintex to complete new SharePoint platform 
•	Creating training manuals and trained staff on utilizing newly developed SharePoint site
•	Currently creating forms using Nintex to assist with workflow management
and possible time management
•	Creating PC SharePoint workflow check-in and check-out for PC loaner program
•	Currently creating database logging system for company PC/Laptop software and hardware
•	Create and maintain websites graphics utilizing Dreamweaver.
•	Create and maintained websites incorporating HTML and CSS scripts.
•	Ensured websites content were optimized for search engines
•	Reviewed Google Analytics to assist clients with site infrastructure and optimization.
•	Create logo designs utilizing Photoshop CS and Xara Design Studio software
•	Create Publications, Flyers, and Business cards utilizing Xara Design Studio, and Photoshop CS, InDesign CS, and ImageReady application software.
•	Created single and multicolor illustrations prints, brochures, advertisements, and displays for clients.
•	Created and designed themes, logos, and color schemes.
•	Produce, coding, Flash animation, design and layout of fully functioning websites.

positions.title: Computer Web Programmer I / Web Developer / DBO / Security Steward
positions.description:
•	Research and organize website server infrastructures.
•	Coordinate and resolve technical issues with the Web Content Management System.
•	Develop and revise user’s manuals for specific responsive design applications.
•	Currently manage several entity relational databases using Microsoft SQL Server.
•	Design and develop entity relational infrastructure diagrams for website application servers.
•	Grant rights and permissions, including removal of users; for applications, servers, and databases.
•	Coordinate with team leads, supervisors, ITSO, ISSO, and clients to ensure all applications and website content requirements are met.
•	Implement 508 accessibility requirements on images and PDFs for website usage.
•	Coordinate, research, and implement all server side application infrastructure scans with the Information System’s Security Office (ISSO). 
•	Migrate website content from previous JavaScript package template to newly approved template packages.
•	Updated website content using HTML, XHTML, CSS, ASP.Net, and JavaScript.
•	Coordinate and implement the conversion of website application development content from Classic ASP to ASP.Net.
•	Develop site application utilizing ASP.net 4.0.
•	Coordinate with Information Technology Services Office (ITSO) with database creation, maintenance, and deletion.
•	Create and redesign stored procedures utilizing MS SQL server.
•	Redesign and maintain application development documentation.
•	Attended Security Stewards, Responsive Design concepts, and Web Team Priorities meetings.
•	Coordinate and implement the creation of Development, Testing, and Staging servers for website application development.
•	Implement safeguards to mitigate application system risks; and perform reviews to ensure applications and servers are operating in accordance with federal policies and procedures.
•	Implement, assist, guide, and support the security of architecture and/or technical issues to both the business steward and internal ITSO department.

company.name: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
